question: Should OpenClaw intentionally fail closed for existing byte-size configs above `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` instead of continuing to round them?
rationale: The patch is technically narrow and correct, but it tightens config validation in a way that could stop an existing setup with an unsafe value until the operator fixes the config.

options.title: Accept fail-closed validation
options.body: Merge as-is and treat unsafe byte-size values as invalid because OpenClaw cannot honor them exactly.

options.title: Add upgrade recovery first
options.body: Require a doctor warning or migration path before runtime/schema validation rejects previously accepted unsafe values.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed validation
recommendation.body: Merge as-is and treat unsafe byte-size values as invalid because OpenClaw cannot honor them exactly.
